plan.title: Closed RFQ Convert to Auction Menu

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Set post-expiry surrogate bidding to Off as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Restrict evaluation reopening as required by the case.
Select Convert to Auction from the RFQ Settings menu, leaving the resulting flow open.
Assert that the conversion flow opens and lists the Continue action.
